endorsements.name: Neal Stephenson
endorsements.label: An Interview  with Neal Stephenson
endorsements.description: Black Hat USA 2012 is proud to welcome one of the world's foremost Historical and Science Fiction authors to our keynote stage.  Get your questions ready!  Attendees will get the chance to ask Mr. Stephenson about his life, processes, and works… But you may want to keep your latest Cryptonomicon conspiracy theories to yourself…as of course, we can neither confirm nor deny their validity.  Join us!
